title: Fallout 4

quotes.text: There's another settlement that needs our help.
Two hundred years ago, I never would have thought this level of dust possible!
I'm a synth. Synthetic man. All the parts, minus a few red blood cells.
Come on, Blue. This isn't amateur hour.
Dogmeat is modeled on lead level designer Joel Burgess's own dog, River, who also voiced his barks.
The $120 Pip-Boy Collector's Edition shipped with a real wearable Pip-Boy that cradled your phone.
Every player has a settlement stockpiled with two hundred desk fans they will never use.
You promise yourself just one more settlement, then the main quest. Still promising it at level 80.
